description: Micro-Batch 4: CWE-1275 SameSite cookie + CWE-208 timing attack

cwes.name: Sensitive Cookie with Improper SameSite Attribute
cwes.sink_pattern: set_cookie() call missing samesite keyword or samesite=None|'None'
cwes.notes: Any call to .set_cookie() is a sink. Flagged when samesite is absent or explicitly None.

cwes.name: Observable Timing Discrepancy
cwes.sink_pattern: ast.Compare with Eq/NotEq where operands contain sensitive identifiers (token/secret/signature/hmac/mac/api_key/auth_token)
cwes.notes: Flag direct == / != on sensitive token variables. Exempt compare_digest calls.
